title: CALMA: A Process for Deriving Context-aligned Axes for Language Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Participatory open-ended interactions with a history education language model, evaluated through Grounded Theory coding (open and focused coding) and group discussions by distinct user communities to identify Western, US, and colonial biases.
Qualitative evaluation through open coding of language model responses to historical queries, capturing user annotations for racial bias, perspectives on slavery, and Indigenous narratives.
Participant-led interactions and subsequent qualitative annotation of language model outputs to identify religious framing and bias in historical contexts.
